start: An open workout, bench press, the member's best so far is 60 kg × 8

steps.action: Log 62.5 kg × 8 and tick the set
user_sees: Confetti falling from the top for about 2 seconds
A pop-up "New record · Bench Press" with a medal
One line per record beaten, like "Heaviest weight · 62.5 kg × 8"
must_not: A record pop-up for a set that beat nothing
"62.5" on one line and "kg" on the next
The confetti taking a tap meant for the set rows

user_sees: The pop-up fades after about 6 seconds
must_not: The pop-up staying on top of the set rows

start: An open workout, same set last time was 60 kg × 8, best is 70 kg × 8

user_sees: A quieter pill line like "+2.5 kg on last time · Bench Press"
must_not: A medal or confetti for a not-a-record set
The line spoken twice by the screen reader

start: The "In use" screen after a set on a machine

steps.action: Tick a record set and let "In use" open
user_sees: The same record pop-up on the "In use" screen
must_not: Two pop-ups, one on each screen

steps.action: Tick a warm-up or a set lighter than last time
must_not: A "last time" line that shows a drop as a gain
It coming back for the same set

steps.action: Untick the record set and tick it again
user_sees: At most one pop-up for that set
must_not: A second record counted for the same set
The record kept after the set was unticked
